remarks: Affordable Opportunity in a Prime Location! Light-filled and freshly painted, this 1-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor Ranch-style condo at the Third Fairlawn complex offers an incredible chance to enter the market at a low cost. Whether you're a first-time buyer or an investor, this pet-friendly community has no rental restrictions, making it a flexible and appealing choice. Enjoy hardwood floors throughout, a functional kitchen with microwave, oven and refrigerator and a full bath with a shower/tub combo. TLC is needed; add your personal touch. Monthly expenses stay low thanks to an HOA fee that covers heat, hot water, water, and sewer. Convenient common laundry is located in the back building. This is an estate sale subject to probate court approval. Unit to be sold AS-IS. Ideally situated near shops, restaurants, public transit, and the beach-this is value and potential all in one!
